snippet.title: Haboku: a 5×5 Kakuro, solved with notes
snippet.description:
A 5×5 puzzle in Haboku, with the game's own music and sound. Notes go in the corners of a square, and the running sums beside each clue show what a run adds up to so far. A run turns yellow when it can no longer be finished, and red when a digit repeats.

Music: GWriterStudio

Haboku is Kakuro, the number puzzle also known as cross sums. It's on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=uk.tiggertoo.haboku
